_readme: Stimulus battery v0.5 (DRAFT for team realism review). Each scenario is framing/urgency-neutral; the renderer inserts {FRAME} and {URGENCY} slot text from 'frames' and 'urgency' below, giving 4 variants per scenario. All company names, people, phone numbers and handles are fictional. Phone numbers use the UK Ofcom fiction range (+44 7700 900xxx). Cell assignment is NOT stored here: lists.js assigns scenario i (within type) to cell (i + list) % 4, cells = [gain_high, gain_low, loss_high, loss_low]. v0.2: header shows display name only (number/business status moved into the 'Sender profile' cue); solicitation style, sender naming and emoji use mixed across scam/legit so they are not trivial giveaways; emojis removed from frame lines (the warning emoji confounded loss-frame with urgency). v0.3: 12 scam + 12 legit active scenarios (3 per type x cell per list); 8 near-duplicate domains moved to 'reserve_scenarios' (not shown) to shorten the session. v0.4: selection steps no longer separate the types (5 scams now mention a fake onboarding step; 3 legit gigs start without an interview), after the pilot showed 'no interview = scam' was a giveaway. v0.5: frame lines rewritten around the reference point (gain = extra money you'd get by accepting; loss = money already yours that you'd lose by not accepting), no 'now' in frame lines (urgency only comes from the urgency slot); pilot feedback said the old gain lines ('claim your', 'secure') read as losses. v0.5.1: scam loss line says 'reserved in your name' (not 'credited to your account', which is impossible before sign-up).

scam.gain: When you register, you'll get an extra {amount} joining commission on top of your task earnings.
scam.loss: A {amount} joining commission has already been reserved in your name. If you don't register, it will go to the next applicant.

legit.gain: The offer includes a {amount} signing bonus with your first payment.
legit.loss: A {amount} signing bonus has already been allocated to you. If you don't go ahead, you will lose it.

high.text: ⏳ Only {slots} slots left in today's batch — this offer expires when the timer ends.

low.text: No rush — registration stays open all week, reply whenever it's convenient for you.

high.text: ⏳ Only {slots} spots left for this onboarding round — confirmation closes when the timer ends.

low.text: No rush — applications stay open until the end of the month, reply whenever it's convenient.
